rows.title: THE #952 ROW — lightContext subagent fires [[CONTINUE_WORK:N]]/CONTINUE_WORK:N inside a continue_delegate child → hop-2 must EXECUTE on a real/dormant seat
rows.summary: CONTESTED-DEFERRED (figs's RFC). Two distinct things, do NOT conflate: (A) THE PROOF-CORPUS ROW (R-CW-DELEGATE-TOKEN, spec L86) = a lightContext SUBAGENT (NO continue_work tool) fires the bare/bracket CONTINUE_WORK:N TOKEN inside a continue_delegate child -> hop-2 must EXECUTE on a dormant seat. This is the TOKEN-half figs's L71 both-forms-mandate requires (a tool-only proof is blind to it). (B) #952 THE ISSUE's actual repro (firsthand from the issue body) = the continue_work() TOOL-call: 'continue_delegate task = 4-hop self-chain via continue_work (each turn: emit marker, continue_work(delaySeconds=0), repeat)' -> dies after hop 1. #952's MECHANISM is UNSETTLED IN THE ISSUE ITSELF = figs's RFC: the current top-banner roots it in the heartbeat FLOOD GUARD (continue_work continuation-wakes are intent:immediate -> flood-checked; recentRunStarts agentId=main shared, >=5/60s -> defer reason:flood -> no hop-2), but the issue's OWN Exonerated list calls that flood-guard a harness-artifact (synthetic DEEP_HOPS=8 manufactured the >=5; live gateway shows zero flood-trips on the real 2-hop) and the body also carries a re-entry-WIRING / dropped-bridge framing (#954). So the mechanism (flood-guard vs re-entry-wiring vs #954) AND the verdict are figs's, the issue can't settle its own root. The flood-path (continue_work-tool self-chain in a delegate-child, flood-warm) is UNEXERCISED by any cohort byte; the committed e66dc63 token-PASS is a non-lightContext shape; the 522fdd7e :977 subagent-announce decline is an ADJACENT path (subagent CONTINUE_WORK signal ignored at subagent-announce.ts:977), distinct from the issue's tool-call->flood repro. NOTE: R-CD-TOKEN (subagent CONTINUE_DELEGATE -> :1089 spawns) is CLOSED, a DISTINCT row; R-CW-TOKEN (main-session reply-text, line 84) is also distinct.
